newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia central bank sees 1.8/2.0 pct 1996 growth.
newsitem.headline: Estonia central bank sees 1.8/2.0 pct 1996 growth.

text.p: The central bank of Estonia said on Monday that economic growth in 1996 could be around two percent, down from the previous forecast of three percent growth.
"According to the trend of the first six months, the economic growth for 1996 could be 1.8 percent to two percent," the central bank said in its latest bulletin.
In the second quarter of 1996 its economic growth index showed a 1.051 point rise compared with the previous quarter and a one point rise versus the same quarter of 1995.
